footer.disclaimer_content: The developers are not responsible for the contents, only for developing the app. The correctness of the contents are the responsibility of the wiki writers.
footer.privacy_policy_content: The app doesn't collect any users data, except the standard app data the OS caches. Users can always empty the caches by opening Settings > Apps > Nias Heritage > Clear cache. For questions users can contact the developer at slaia@yahoo.com.

heritage.architecture_desc: Delve into the ancestral heritage of the Nis people in building their eartquake-resistant traditional wooden houses.
heritage.arts_desc: Traditional Nias arts: songs, dances, hoho speeches, musical instruments, carvings, and ornaments.
heritage.clothing_desc: Traditional Nias attire, its colors and motifs, as well as other accessories.
heritage.megalith_desc: Carved stone monuments (behu and daro-daro) erected to commemorate ancestors and mark social status within the village.
heritage.origin_desc: DNA and archaeological research reveal the origins of the Nias people as part of an ancient human migration from the Asian continent that traversed the Indonesian archipelago.
heritage.subtitle: Explore the rich architecture, arts, attire, megaliths, villages, origin, and history timeline of Tanö Niha.
heritage.timeline_desc: Beginning 12,000 years ago, with written records appearing from the 1st century AD onwards, it developed through the colonial era and into the period of independence.
heritage.title: Heritage & Culture
heritage.village_desc: Social stratification, kinship systems, and laws governing aspects of social life.

heritage_badges.origin: Tracing the origins based on DNA and archeological research
heritage_badges.timeline: An overview of 12,000 years of Nias history
heritage_badges.village: The village and the social system of the Nias people

home.explore_subtitle: Tap a topic below to explore Nias literature and history
home.heritage_subtitle: Uncover the wonders of Nias: from ancient megaliths and traditional architecture to vibrant dances, attire, and the fascinating history of Ono Niha.
home.interactive_subtitle: Immerse yourself in the Nias language with interactive crosswords and lessons, connect with the community, or admire our curated gallery of arts and culture.
home.library_subtitle: Deep dive into Nias language and culture: practice proverbs and Hoho speeches, explore folklores and songs, or study the Nias Bible.
home.purpose_desc: Nias Heritage is a curated digital repository dedicated to preserving, documenting, and showcasing the rich history, oral traditions, cultural artifacts, and language of Nias Island, Indonesia.
home.subtitle: Discover the ancient culture, history, and language of Tanö Niha.
